title: Fix Design Test Zero Piece Nodes and Drag Hang
description: The Design Playwright test passes but finds 0 piece nodes (should find 180 for Nakagin Capsule Tower). The react-flow__node elements are not rendering. This means the drag test is skipped entirely and never exercises mouse.up(). Root cause investigation from previous sessions confirmed onNodeDragStop causes the hang, but proper fix requires nodes to render first.
summary: Fixed 3 bugs causing Design test failure: (1) Hook order violation in PanelTabContent - useLabel called inside .map() violating Rules of Hooks, causing React to unmount entire component tree and lose all 180 ReactFlow nodes. Fix: extracted PanelTabSectionItem FC. (2) onNodeDragStop center update guard too restrictive - else-if checked currentSelection.pieces.length which was 0 for unselected dragged nodes. Fix: changed to unconditional else block. (3) KitStore dirty flag not propagated - DesignStore.markDirty() only set its own dirty flag, not parent KitStore. KitStore.snapshot() returned cached stale data after piece center updates. Fix: added this.parent.markDirty() to DesignStore.markDirty(). All 6 Playwright tests pass (3.7m).
